C0611.title: Beijing No. 2 Intermediate Court Reports on Loan Diversion Cases Involving Financial Institutions
C0611.summary: On November 14, 2025, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court held a briefing on private lending disputes involving on-lending of funds obtained from financial institutions. From 2022 to September 2025, the court heard 172 such cases and found 118 to constitute on-lending. Credit-card cash-out on-lending accounted for about 30% of the cases. Such private lending contracts are invalid, although borrowers generally still have to return principal and compensate for fund occupation losses.
